theorems.name: Submission.trace_comp_adjoint_comp_swap_of_symm
theorems.statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (A S : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn N) (P : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn n), (∀ v w : Rn n, inner ℝ (P v) w = inner ℝ v (P w)) → LinearMap.trace ℝ (Rn n) (P ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint S ∘L A).toLinearMap = LinearMap.trace ℝ (Rn n) (P ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint A ∘L S).toLinearMap
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
